@graph.rdfs:comment: A person who has flown, or trained to fly, in space (astronaut, cosmonaut, taikonaut).
A named spaceflight mission or flight, for example Apollo 11, Vostok 1 or Shenzhou 5.
A space agency or company that operates missions, for example NASA, Roscosmos or SpaceX.
A spaceport or launch complex, for example Baikonur Cosmodrome or Kennedy Space Center.
A country or geographic region, for example Kazakhstan, Florida or French Guiana.
A crewed spacecraft or launch vehicle type, for example Soyuz, Crew Dragon or Saturn V.
The astronaut flew as a crew member on the mission.
The agency or company that operated the mission.
The agency that selected or employed the astronaut.
The launch site the mission lifted off from.
The country or region where the launch site is located.
The spacecraft or launch vehicle the mission used.
